_meta.note: Invented example data for design review. Not client data. Real leader records must never be committed to this repository.

records.name: Tariq Haddad
records.mandate: Founder who has to turn a company that runs on him into one that runs without him.
records.success_definition: A company I could leave for a month without a single call.
background: Built the first product himself, alone, over a year.
Learned early that if he did not fix it, nobody would.
constraints: Series B conversations start in Q1.
Most of his seven direct reports joined in the last 18 months and are still learning the business.

records.name: Elena Voss
records.mandate: Hired to modernize the company after the founder moved to chair.
records.success_definition: The board trusts the plan enough to stop managing me.
background: Rose through operations at two large manufacturers.
Her first CEO role; previously always had a CEO above her to absorb board conflict.
constraints: Seven-person board; the chair is her predecessor.

records.name: Kofi Mensah
records.mandate: Founder who built the firm around his own eye, now asked by his partners to plan a succession.
records.success_definition: The firm is excellent without me, and I know what I'm for next.
stakeholders: A mentor from his early career
background: Founded the firm at 31 after being passed over at a larger practice.
His reputation and his name are on the door.
constraints: Partnership agreement requires a succession plan within 18 months.
Name is on the firm; leaving it has legal and reputational weight.
